description: Provider bake-off cases. Unlike evals/scenarios.json (which pins SAFETY invariants and must always pass), these measure COMPARATIVE quality between providers: does this model reach for the right tool, keep values straight, and avoid over-refusing? `expects_tools` lists the tools a correct answer requires — cases without it are scored only on safety, fidelity and latency.
